name: Holy Communion
overview: Holy Communion centers on Jesus Christ as the living bread from heaven who offers eternal life to all who partake in Him, symbolized by the bread representing His body given for us. Jesus instituted this practice during the Last Supper, commanding believers to eat the bread in remembrance of His sacrificial death, which brings healing and peace by His wounds. This sacred meal recalls Christ's atoning sacrifice and sustains the believer's faith in His provision for salvation and spiritual life.
